commands.name: marathon-plan
commands.hostDescription: Plan a marathon from the saved Workflow data, using this host's delegate or session fallback

commands.name: marathon-run
commands.hostDescription: Plan and run a marathon, or run the saved plan, using this host's delegate or session fallback

pending.run.gemini:
!{sh "{{SKILLS}}/tickets-zordon/scripts/pending.sh"}

Above is the output of tickets-zordon's pending script for this repo. Paste it to me unchanged; it reads, it never edits the board.

pending-subagent.delegate.all: the host's subagent tool (none: run each stored prompt yourself, one at a time, in a fresh context, and say so)

pending-subagent.review.all: a code review of the staged diff (`/code-review` where the host has it);

verify-subagent.fallback.all:
run tests only: they never edit code, commit or touch TICKETS.md. No subagent on this host ->
   check each ticket yourself in turn, under the same read-and-run-only rule.

code-vader.execute.gemini: 1. **Collect diff & debt markers** - Run `!{sh "{{SKILLS}}/code-vader/scripts/code-vader.sh" collect {{args}}}` Read the changed files and callers of modified symbols before judging.
code-vader.execute.all: 1. **Collect diff & debt markers** — Run `sh skills/code-vader/scripts/code-vader.sh collect $ARGUMENTS` (Windows: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/code-vader/scripts/code-vader.ps1 collect $ARGUMENTS`). Read the changed files and callers of modified symbols before judging.

skillator-sync.execute.gemini: 1. **Sweep (check)** - Run `!{sh "{{SKILLS}}/skillator-sync/scripts/skillator-sync.sh" {{args}}}` Show every `unchanged`, `changed`, and `error` row plus the `summary:` line. All `unchanged` -> stop.
skillator-sync.execute.all: 1. **Sweep (`check`)** — Run `sh skills/skillator-sync/scripts/skillator-sync.sh` (Windows: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/skillator-sync/scripts/skillator-sync.ps1`) with `$ARGUMENTS` (default `check`). Show every `unchanged`, `changed`, and `error` row plus the `summary:` line. All `unchanged` → stop.

team.invocation.all:
Load the `tickets-zordon` skill (skillator:tickets-zordon) and run the team or ticket assignment action for this repo.
For each `ticket-meta` invocation below use `sh {{SKILLS}}/tickets-zordon/scripts/ticket-meta.sh`
(on Windows: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File {{SKILLS}}/tickets-zordon/scripts/ticket-meta.ps1`), followed by the shown arguments.

message-uhura.delivery.all: `node "<skill dir>/scripts/team.mjs" message @handle --file <path-to-temp-file>` (and reply via `node "<skill dir>/scripts/team.mjs" say --file <path-to-temp-file>` when replying)

marathon-plan.plan-format.all: On this host /marathon-run reads it as data ("Run without the Workflow tool"), never executes it.

marathon-plan.plan-end.cursor: - on this host with the Task tool, one Task per agent.
marathon-plan.plan-end.pi: - on this host with the subagent extension when installed, else the phases in order in this session.
marathon-plan.plan-end.opencode: - on this host with the phases in order in this session (no delegate verified here).
marathon-plan.plan-end.antigravity: - on this host with agy: background subagents; codex: subagents; Gemini CLI: in this session.
marathon-plan.plan-end.gemini: - on this host with the phases in order in this session (no delegate verified here).

marathon-run.execution.all: the plan. The `.workflow.js` is read as data (`meta.phases`, `PLAN`), never executed.

marathon-run.dispatch.cursor: , driver `@cu-<6>`, `--owner task`) before the agent that runs it exists
marathon-run.dispatch.pi: , driver `@pi-<6>`, `--owner subagent` with the subagent extension, else `--owner session`) before its work starts
marathon-run.dispatch.opencode: , driver `@oc-<6>`, `--owner session`) before its work starts
marathon-run.dispatch.antigravity: ; agy: driver `@agy-<6>`, `--owner subagent`; codex: driver `@cx-<6>`, `--owner subagent`; Gemini CLI: driver `@gm-<6>`, `--owner session`) before its work starts
marathon-run.dispatch.gemini: , driver `@gm-<6>`, `--owner session`) before its work starts

marathon-run.parallel.cursor: A phase's tickets run at once through the Task tool, so the mode is the phase shape.
marathon-run.parallel.pi: With the subagent extension a phase's tickets run at once, so the mode is the phase shape. Otherwise in this session a phase's tickets run one after another - a parallel plan runs serial here, say so in the first line.
marathon-run.parallel.opencode: In this session a phase's tickets run one after another - a parallel plan runs serial here, say so in the first line.
marathon-run.parallel.antigravity: On agy/codex a phase's tickets run at once through subagents, so the mode is the phase shape. On Gemini CLI a phase's tickets run one after another - a parallel plan runs serial here, say so in the first line.
marathon-run.parallel.gemini: In this session a phase's tickets run one after another - a parallel plan runs serial here, say so in the first line.

marathon-run.delegate.cursor: , through the Task tool, one Task per agent (a phase's tickets as several Task calls in one turn)
marathon-run.delegate.pi: , through the subagent extension when installed, else in this session - the stored prompt done, then the verify text done as a second pass that edits nothing
marathon-run.delegate.opencode: , in this session (no delegate verified here) - the stored prompt done, then the verify text done as a second pass that edits nothing
marathon-run.delegate.antigravity: - agy: background subagents; codex: subagents (one subagent per ticket of the phase); Gemini CLI: in this session (no delegate verified there), the stored prompt done, then the verify text done as a second pass that edits nothing
marathon-run.delegate.gemini: , in this session (no delegate verified here) - the stored prompt done, then the verify text done as a second pass that edits nothing
